title: fix(agent-loop): keep every Ollama streamed tool call, not just the last chunk's

files.patch:
@@ -269,6 +269,7 @@ async def stream(
 
         text_parts: list[str] = []
         final_raw_message: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        stream_tool_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
         usage = TokenUsage()
         try:
             async with self._client.stream("POST", "/api/chat", json=payload) as response:
@@ -283,6 +284,9 @@ async def stream(
                         text_parts.append(delta)
                         yield TextDeltaEvent(delta=delta)
                     if msg.get("tool_calls"):
+                        # Ollama can spread several tool calls over multiple chunks;
+                        # accumulate them instead of keeping only the last chunk's.
+                        stream_tool_calls.extend(msg["tool_calls"])
                         final_raw_message = msg
                     if chunk.get("done"):
                         usage = self._usage_from(chunk)
@@ -292,5 +296,8 @@ async def stream(
             raise self._wrap_error(exc, "stream") from exc
 
         final_text = "".join(text_parts) or final_raw_message.get("content") or None
-        message = self._parse_message({**final_raw_message, "content": final_text})
+        final_raw_message = {**final_raw_message, "content": final_text}
+        if stream_tool_calls:
+            final_raw_message["tool_calls"] = stream_tool_calls
+        message = self._parse_message(final_raw_message)
         yield StreamCompleteEvent(response=ModelResponse(message=message, usage=usage, model=resolved_model))

@@ -445,6 +445,21 @@ async def test_tool_calls_captured_in_final_message(self) -> None:
         final = next(e for e in events if isinstance(e, StreamCompleteEvent)).response
         assert final.message.tool_calls[0].name == "search"
 
+    async def test_tool_calls_across_chunks_are_all_kept(self) -> None:
+        transport = _transport()
+        lines = self._ndjson(
+            {"message": {"content": "", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"name": "search", "arguments": {"q": "x"}}}]}},
+            {"message": {"content": "", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"name": "fetch", "arguments": {"u": "y"}}}]}},
+            {"message": {"content": ""}, "done": True},
+        )
+        fake_response = _FakeStreamResponse(lines)
+        transport._client.stream = MagicMock(return_value=_FakeStreamCM(fake_response))
+
+        events = [event async for event in transport.stream([UserMessage(content="search")])]
+        final = next(e for e in events if isinstance(e, StreamCompleteEvent)).response
+        assert [tc.name for tc in final.message.tool_calls] == ["search", "fetch"]
+        assert [tc.id for tc in final.message.tool_calls] == ["call_0", "call_1"]
+
     async def test_done_without_prior_message_uses_final_chunk_message(self) -> None:
